Sofia pitched a fish, and the team split the strokes fast. Priya laid the start at the nose, Sofia took the body, and Tom, Maya, Omar and Leo took the tail. Early on, the tail lines tangled. Maya couldn't see the upper line climbing, so Hana asked Tom to get it going toward the top point. Priya patched the joint where body met tail.

The real trouble was the tail edge. Leo's edge curled off to the right, and Priya, Sam, Grace, Sofia and Hana all flagged it. Hana and Sam pulled the stray pieces, and Leo re-laid the edge straight down between the tips. With two minutes left, Omar bridged the gap at the top. Hana called out, "Let it stand," and everyone took their hands off. Every player called it a fish. In the end, 136 of 166 dominoes fell.
